title: The promotion of fatty acid beta-oxidation by hesperidin via activating SIRT1/PGC1alpha to improve NAFLD induced by a high-fat diet.
authors: Nie, Tong; Wang, Xin; Li, Aqun; Shan, Anshan; Ma, Jun
one_liner_zh: 该文研究橙皮苷通过SIRT1/PGC1alpha通路促进脂肪酸β氧化改善NAFLD，属于代谢疾病机制研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Reducing fat deposits in hepatocytes is a direct treatment for nonalcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) and the fatty acid metabolic processes mediated by fatty acid beta-oxidation are important for the prevention of NAFLD. In this study, we established high-fat-diet models in vitro and in vivo to investigate the mechanism by which hesperidin (HDN) prevents NAFLD by modulating fatty acid beta oxidation. Based on LC-MS screening of differential metabolites, many metabolites involved in phospholipid and lipid metabolism were found to be significantly altered and closely associated with fatty acid beta-oxidation. The results from COIP experiments indicated that HDN increased the deacetylation of PGC1alpha by SIRT1. In addition, the results of CETSA and molecular docking experiments suggest that HDN targeting of SIRT1 plays an important role in their stable binding. Meanwhile, it was found that HDN reduced fatty acid uptake and synthesis and promoted the expression of SIRT1/PGC1alpha and fatty acid beta-oxidation, and the latter process was inhibited after transfection to knockdown SIRT1. The results suggest that HDN improves NAFLD by promoting fatty acid beta-oxidation through activating SIRT1/PGC1alpha. Thus, the findings indicate that HDN may be a potential drug for the treatment of NAFLD.
abstract_zh: 减少肝细胞中的脂肪沉积是非酒精性脂肪性肝病（NAFLD）的直接治疗方法，而由脂肪酸β-氧化介导的脂肪酸代谢过程对于预防NAFLD至关重要。在本研究中，我们建立了体外和体内的高脂饮食模型，以探讨橙皮苷（HDN）通过调节脂肪酸β-氧化预防NAFLD的机制。基于LC-MS对差异代谢物的筛选，发现许多参与磷脂和脂质代谢的代谢物显著改变，并与脂肪酸β-氧化密切相关。COIP实验结果表明，HDN通过SIRT1增加了PGC1α的去乙酰化。此外，CETSA和分子对接实验的结果提示，HDN靶向SIRT1在其稳定结合中发挥重要作用。同时，研究发现HDN减少了脂肪酸的摄取和合成，并促进了SIRT1/PGC1α及脂肪酸β-氧化的表达，而在转染敲低SIRT1后，该过程受到抑制。结果表明，HDN通过激活SIRT1/PGC1α促进脂肪酸β-氧化，从而改善NAFLD。因此，这些发现表明HDN可能是治疗NAFLD的潜在药物。
